_description: Dataset of known error patterns + fixes. Each entry has: pattern, file_glob, fix, lesson. Used by pre-deploy-check.py to catch recurring errors before deploy.

errors.description: Component uses a lucide-react icon (as <Icon /> or icon={Icon}) but the icon is not imported from 'lucide-react'
errors.detection: grep for icon names in JSX (PascalCase identifiers used as JSX elements or as icon={...} props) that are not in the import list
errors.fix: Add the missing icon name to the import statement from 'lucide-react'
errors.lesson: Always verify ALL icons used in a component are imported. Run pre-deploy-check.py before deploying.
errors.example: admin-panel.tsx used FileText icon but didn't import it — crashed when admin panel rendered

errors.description: Frontend interface expects field X but API endpoint returns field Y (different name)
errors.detection: Compare interface declarations in .tsx with Response.json() calls in .ts API routes
errors.fix: Align the interface field name with the API response field name (or vice versa)
errors.lesson: When adding new API endpoints or changing response shapes, update the frontend interface to match.
errors.example: AdminStats interface had totalModules but /api/admin/stats returned totalGames — showed undefined in UI

errors.description: MultiEdit partially applied — variable was renamed via destructuring but old references remain
errors.detection: grep for old variable name after MultiEdit — should be 0 matches if fully applied
errors.fix: Replace remaining old references with new destructured name
errors.lesson: After MultiEdit, always grep for the old name to verify 0 matches.
errors.example: screenCv destructured to startScreenCv/stopScreenCv but 3 references to screenCv.start/stop remained — runtime ReferenceError

errors.description: Same variable declared twice in the same scope (e.g., const isScreenMode twice)
errors.detection: grep for 'const VARNAME' in same file — should be 1 match per scope
errors.fix: Remove the duplicate declaration (keep the one in the right scope)
errors.lesson: When adding new code, check if the variable already exists before declaring it.
errors.example: Added const isScreenMode at top of STTPanel but it was already declared later — esbuild error

checklist_before_deploy: Verify: npm run build succeeds without warnings
Verify: agent-browser opens /edu without runtime errors
Verify: all API endpoints respond (smoke test via curl)
Verify: PM2 log shows no new error lines after restart
